lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: There. On the cliff face. You can see the tidal calculations carved into the retaining wall.
lines.monologue: His pace changed. Not faster, exactly. More certain. The way someone walks toward a place they've been dreaming about returning to.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.lens: Cut into stone that's been weathered by salt spray for centuries and still legible. Whoever made these expected them to outlast the people reading them.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: The archive towers are built to follow the tide cycles. High windows face east for morning light during research hours. Lower chambers flood intentionally during spring tides — it's how they tested waterproofing for their manuscripts.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: The breakwater channels the current toward the fishing coves. Deliberate. Whoever designed this understood how to make the ocean work for them instead of against them.
lines.monologue: She traced the water line with her eyes. Reading the coast the way Lex reads inscriptions. Different language, same attention.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: The Velundrath Compact. They believed knowledge and survival were the same discipline.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: Not danger. Depth. Like standing at the edge of a well and feeling the air rise from below. The whole settlement sits on something older than its foundations. He couldn't name it. He didn't need to.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: You're feeling the resonance layer. The original settlement was built on a threshold site. Most of the records about it were lost, but the architecture preserves the alignments.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: That's consistent with the accounts I've read. The thresholds here were described as 'listening places.' Observation without intention.
lines.monologue: He said it gently. Not correcting. Confirming. The difference between a teacher and a colleague.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Tides shift in four hours. If we need supplies from the lower market, we should go now before the causeways flood.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: The trade post near the second tower. I know someone who sources through here. If they're still operating, we can resupply without overpaying.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I'd like to visit the archive reading room. Just briefly.
lines.monologue: He said 'briefly' the way people do when they already know it won't be brief. But nobody called him on it. Some kinds of homecoming deserve their own pace.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: We'll regroup at the harbor wall before the tide turns.
lines.monologue: Lex was already walking toward the towers. Not rushing. Just pulled, the way water follows a slope. This place fits him the way a well-worn coat fits. Quietly. Without announcement.
